messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 我目前沒有可用的工具來查詢即時的個人運動員排名。若您需要最新的ATP或WTA世界排名，建議直接參考官方網站（如ATP/WTA）或使用專門提供個人排名查詢的API。

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer with knowledge: As of 2026, top male ATP ranking is Novak Djokovic? Actually as of 2026, maybe it's still Djokovic or maybe it's someone else. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide approximate. But better to respond that I can't fetch real-time ranking. So we should say we don't have function for that.
